summary:
• GPT‑6 — OpenAI's latest ChatGPT model with an Intelligent UI that adds interactive panels, buttons and live widgets inside the chat, enabling rapid prototyping.
• Claude Haiku 5.5 — Anthropic's small, low‑cost model with an adjustable effort knob, offering fast, cheap performance for high‑volume tasks like log summarisation and short‑text classification.
• Mistral Large 4 — Mistral AI's 7‑billion‑parameter model that balances speed and reasoning depth, suitable for single‑GPU inference and providing a modest upgrade over existing Mistral 7B deployments.
• EmbeddingGemma 2 — A lightweight multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4 that unifies text, code, image, video and audio vectors for on‑device, privacy‑first search.
• AI System Design guide — An open‑source, step‑by‑step notebook that shows how to build LLM‑centric retrieval, generation and autonomous‑agent pipelines, providing ready‑made scaffolding and evaluation scripts.
• Strands‑decider — A lightweight “system‑one” decision model supporting Apple‑silicon, CUDA and vision inputs, offering faster choice selection than full LLMs for routing and tool‑selection in agent workflows.
